body.body: Hi @Jacobjeevan @gigincg @nihal467 , kindly assign this issue to me. Here is my approach for fixing the issue: ### Analysis: 1. Issue lies in the `CreateInvoice.tsx` file 2. Grid component is being used for alignment 3. For the misaligned padding, issue is in the file `CreateInvoiceSheet.tsx` due to the use of class `-mx-4` ### Approach to fix: 1. Use of `items-start` class to align form items, i.e. "Payment Terms" and "Note" to the top thus not disturbing the alignment on expanding any textarea. 2. Removal of class `-mx-4` ### Screenshot post fix:
